reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text:
Crave is ridiculously overpriced for what it offers. I pay over $14 a month and STILL have to deal with an absurd amount of ads. The ad-free plan costs even more, while other streaming services offer ad-free viewing for less than what Crave charges for its ad-supported plan.

The ads are unbearable. I get 4 ads every 2 minutes, and sometimes I end up watching 8 ads in what feels like no time. Even worse, if I close the app and come back, it makes me watch the ads all over again. It also starts playing just 2–3 seconds before another ad marker, so I barely get to watch anything before another round of ads starts.

To make things worse, sometimes Crave takes me back to a completely different episode. When I press play, I have to sit through ads, only to realize it’s the wrong episode. I go back to select the correct one, and guess what? MORE ADS. I’m literally being punished with ads for trying to watch the right episode.

Honestly, this is the worst streaming service I’ve ever used. Even illegal streaming websites offer a better viewing experience, which says a lot about how bad Crave is. Why would I pay over $14 a month for an app that makes watching a show this frustrating? I’m cancelling my subscription, and I’d tell anyone considering Crave to save their money and stay away. This is an absolutely terrible streaming experience, and I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone.

reviews.title: Garbage ad loop app
reviews.text:
For years, the app across Fire TV Stick, Apple TV, and iOS has been fundamentally broken. The user experience is deliberately engineered to frustrate subscribers into paying for an ad-free tier by weaponizing technical failures:
 Abusive Ad Saturation: The ad volume is staggering. It is standard to experience multiple ad breaks within a few minutes of content, frequently resulting in more ad time than actual programming. When a show reaches 3/4 of the way through, it forces another ad break, only to repeat ads immediately when the episode concludes.
 Intentional Progress Tracking Failures: The app consistently fails to remember watch history, dumping users back into random points in past episodes.
 The Ad-Loop Trap: When the app loses user placement and forces manual scrubbing or fast-forwarding, it triggers entire ad sequences all over again, compounding the user-hostile design.
This is a complete scam designed to wear down paying subscribers into upgrading to a nearly doubled subscription fee for an ad-free experience. Fix your platform architecture and address these egregious ad loops.

reviews.title: Worst streaming channel that money can buy
reviews.text:
I only got Crave to watch euphoria. I got the simple package with ads because 22 dollars a month for crave is insane. First of all, theres ads like every 5 minutes. it’s ridiculous. Second, it never keeps track of where you left your show. Ive had to go through episodes like 5 times because it keeps taking me back to a couple episodes before. Third, it just doesnt work. Its always saying theres an issue with playing the show or movie regardless of my internet stability or device im on. Forth, it randomly logs me out. 

Dont get crave! Ill be canceling as soon as im done euphoria lol. Whenever that will be…

reviews.title: Can’t stream 4K without app. Slow
reviews.text: Crave is such a poor service that i was compelled to write this,  i had no idea you CANNOT play 4K videos even if you pay for it on WEBSITE. ONLY on app and even then i highly suspect its rendering in 4K since its vastly noticeable when compared to YouTube.  It’s also often quite slow in terms of moving forward or rewinding.

reviews.title: Bell switch to Crave
reviews.text:
I downloaded the App as Bell has made a switch. Most of the shows I would choose to watch require me me to pay 21.99 a month to access. 
I feel the switch from Bell Media to Crave is not a good move for me. Time will tell as I try to access the shows / movies I would like to watch that requires $. I might have to reassess and cancel.

reviews.title: Apple TV app and subtitles? What is going on
reviews.text: The subtitles for TV show have to be re-enabled at the beginning of every episode when on autoplay to next episode. Why can’t my preference to just have subtitles on for all episodes carry over to the next episode? I noticed this issue recently, so not sure if an app update messed this up

reviews.title: Will not renew
reviews.text: Way too many ads and it constantly buffers where Netflix and prime do not.

reviews.title: Awful App
reviews.text: It’s a terrible app with many bugs that have been happening for over a year with no fix. You’ll be watching an episode of a show and after an Ad it skips to the next episode. Sometimes you can go back and finish your previous episode but most of the time it just keeps going to the next episode. Sometimes after an ad the ready to cast screen comes up and won’t let you cast the current episode it cut off on.

reviews.title: Terrible update.
reviews.text: What a complete downgrade for the most recent update. Makes it impossible to find any show unless it’s one they are promoting. No ability to filter by network or hbo. Garbage.
